plugin.name: 9Now Live TV
plugin.description: Nine Network live TV for Jellyfin. Pulls channels, stream URLs, EPG and artwork live from the 9Now service, served to Jellyfin via its built-in M3U tuner and XmlTV provider.
plugin.overview: Nine Network (Channel 9, 9Gem, 9Go!, 9Life, 9Rush + FAST channels) live in the Jellyfin UI with guide data.
